channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.2.4
item.description:
MyStat 0.2.4 shows the battery percentage in the Power card when the Mac has a battery, with its state (On battery, Plugged in or Charging) and a matching battery symbol. A Mac without a battery now reads Plugged in instead of On battery.
macOS 27 is the primary target; macOS 26 remains supported until macOS 28 is released. macOS 27 power-sensor mappings remain experimental. Automatic update checks remain off by default; no telemetry or new runtime dependencies.
Tested with the automated and Sparkle integration suites, and actual-app checks of the candidate on macOS 26.6 and 27.0.1 and on an Apple Silicon MacBook. Prepared with substantial AI assistance (Claude Code).
